test_reindex_level: test reindexing a DataFrame or Series by a specific level of a MultiIndex
test_reindex_preserve_levels: test that reindexing a MultiIndex DataFrame preserves the index reference
test_groupby_transform: test groupby transform on a Series with MultiIndex using level values as grouper
test_groupby_multilevel: test groupby with multiple levels of a MultiIndex and verify consistency with explicit level arrays
test_level_with_tuples: test selecting data from a Series or DataFrame with tuple elements in MultiIndex levels
test_reindex_level_partial_selection: test partial selection on a MultiIndex using reindex or loc with a list of level values
test_multiindex_with_na: test setting a value at a missing MultiIndex key using .at to expand the index
test_multiindex_insert_level_with_na: test inserting a column at a MultiIndex column position with NaN level value
test_alignment: test arithmetic alignment between two Series with different MultiIndex values
test_sort_non_lexsorted: test sorting a DataFrame with non-monotonic MultiIndex index
